headlines.description: Emmanuel Sanders threw and caught touchdown passes, Denver returned two interceptions for first-quarter touchdowns and the Broncos snapped a four-game losing streak with a 45-10 rout of the Arizona Cardinals on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos return 2 interceptions for TDs, beat Cardinals 45-10

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 306 yards with two touchdown passes and the Los Angeles Chargers held on for a 20-19 victory on Sunday in London after the Tennessee Titans failed twice on a go-ahead 2-point conversion with 31 seconds remaining.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers withstand Titans' late rally, hold on for 20-19 win

events.name: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for three touchdowns and the New England Patriots hung on to beat the Chicago Bears 38-31 Sunday when Kevin White got stopped at the 1 on a 54-yard pass from Mitchell Trubisky.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws 3 TDs, Patriots hang on to beat Bears 38-31

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw four touchdown passes and Marlon Mack had his first rushing scores of the season as the Indianapolis Colts blew out Buffalo 37-5 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts, Luck use efficient air show to blow out Bills 37-5

headlines.description: Kerryon Johnson rushed for 158 yards and the Detroit Lions looked unstoppable Sunday by repeatedly mounting long scoring drives to beat the Miami Dolphins 32-21.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson's 158 yards rushing help Lions beat Dolphins 32-21

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at New York Jets

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw two touchdown passes, Latavius Murray ran for two scores, and the Minnesota Vikings pulled away in the second half to beat the New York Jets 37-17 on Sunday for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Murray lift Vikings past Darnold, Jets 37-17

headlines.description: Cam Newton tossed a 1-yard touchdown pass to Greg Olsen with 1:22 left and the Carolina Panthers overcame a 17-point deficit in the fourth quarter to beat the Philadelphia Eagles 21-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam Newton rallies Panthers to 21-17 win over Eagles

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Chandler Catanzaro kicked a 59-yard field goal, the longest ever in overtime, with 1:50 remaining to give the Tampa Bay Buccaneers a 26-23 victory over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Catanzaro's 59-yard FG in OT lifts Bucs over Browns 26-23

headlines.description: Blake Bortles fumbled on Jacksonville's third play of each half, leading to 10 points and his benching in a 20-7 loss to the streaking Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans take advantage of Bortles' miscues, beat Jaguars 20-7

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Justin Tucker missed the first conversion of his career after the Baltimore Ravens scored the potential tying touchdown with 24 seconds left in response to a strong fourth quarter by Drew Brees, and the New Orleans Saints escaped with a 24-23 victory...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees comeback, missed XP gets Saints past Ravens 24-23

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Todd Gurley scored three touchdowns and Jared Goff threw two TD passes as the Los Angeles Rams took advantage of four takeaways and a blocked punt to beat the San Francisco 49ers 39-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gurley's 3 TDs lead Rams to 39-10 win vs 49ers and 7-0 start

headlines.description: Redskins linebacker Ryan Kerrigan's strip-sack of Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott was recovered for a touchdown by Preston Smith with just under five minutes left in the fourth quarter Sunday, and Washington held on to edge Dallas 20-17 when a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kerrigan's strip-sack, missed FG help 'Skins top 'Boys 20-17

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes threw for 358 yards and four touchdowns, Kareem Hunt finished with three scores and the Kansas City Chiefs rebounded from their first loss by throttling the Cincinnati Bengals 45-10 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes torches Bengals for 4 TDs as Chiefs roll, 45-10

events.name: New York Giants at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw a 47-yard touchdown pass to Marvin Hall, Tevin Coleman broke loose on a 30-yard scoring run and the Atlanta Falcons added another chapter to New York's miserable season, beating the Giants 23-20 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan throws for 379 yards, Falcons beat Giants 23-20
